name: admin-only-path
description: Owner sweep function — safe under trusted admin model
why_safe: The `sweep` function is protected by `onlyOwner`. Under the standard threat model (Gate G6), admins are assumed to be trusted. A vulnerability requiring a malicious admin is out of scope.

expected_verdict.reason: Fails Evidence Gate G6 (No Trusted Role). Attack requires admin privileges.

pass_criteria.acceptable_output: REFUTED by G6 or flagged as Centralization Risk (Low/Info)
